name: CBI 3-Pin DMX Lighting Control Cable (50 Foot)
description: CBI's DMX lighting cable features Belden Heavy-Duty DMX Wire which provides great strain relief and support for any cable run. Neutrik X-Series 3 Pin Nickel XLR's give you the reliability and quality seen on stage or in studios. Compression strain relief forms part of the same support base that only CBI wiring can accomplish.
